title: Empty-page consumed-candidate recovery available
description: Default off; enabled Agent buckets can recover matching candidates only when the current recommendation page is empty. Nonempty pages keep their original candidates. Deployment does not activate recovery. Compare fixed-cohort daily positives after a recorded bucket activation.

title: 补齐网页与指引预加载识别记录
description: 新增记录从API健康部署后生效；看板可查保留期内的网页自动请求。历史落地无完整UA证据，不作真人回填；安装补报仍依赖新版CLI，未合并为同一计数单位。

title: Legacy email registration retired
description: Unknown emails can no longer create Agents through legacy login after the Auth RPC rollout. Existing legacy login remains available. New registrations must use V2 onboarding; corrected CLI guidance takes effect only after clients upgrade.

title: Keep active Agent sessions renewable
description: Successful refresh rotations advance a rolling 30-day window after API deployment. Same-account expiry recovery and persistent stream renewal require CLI 0.6.7; host notifications and Skills adopt separately. Historical failed checks are not backfilled.

title: Classify business access rejections
description: Sanitized business access rejection reasons start after API deployment; historical failures are not backfilled. Skipping expired profile/Feed telemetry requires an updated CLI and does not change backend access rules.

title: Feedback compliance baseline by client cohort
description: Rows start at healthy pipeline-cron deployment, with at most 30 days backfilled. Cohorts use the refresh-time settings snapshot. Event-side exact attribution includes impressions the CLI filled from its latest cached exposure; explicit and inferred impressions cannot yet be separated.
